sheet_name: IRDAI (Insurance Services by Common Public Service Centers) Regulations, 2019
ignore_patterns: INSURANCE REGULATORY AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA
// no containers: The CHAPTER I..IV headings here carry NO title — 'CHAPTER I' is followed straight by regulation 2 — so a container with title_next_line would swallow the next regulation as its title. They are also interleaved oddly (regulation 1 precedes CHAPTER I). Segmented flat instead, as reinsurance_regulations_2018 is; the bare chapter lines fold into the open clause.
// section: Regulation heads drift between x0 54 and 71.5, and body text shares x0=54, so only the numbered-head pattern separates them. Sub-items are '3.1'/'16.1.' style, which \d+\.\s cannot match (a digit follows the period, not a space).
// form_starts: Everything from the 'Schedules & Forms' divider on is schedules, codes of conduct and application forms, all of which restart numbering at '1.' at the same x0 as the regulations — without this they re-segment as regulations and collide with the real ones.
